guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, idle_o is driven to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True (idle).
On rising clk_i edge, if sha3_fsm equals sha3_pkg::StIdle and (msgfifo_empty or SecIdleAcceptSwMsg) is true, idle_o becomes MuBi4True.
Otherwise, on rising clk_i edge, idle_o is set to MuBi4False (not idle).
guarantees.cond: posedge clk_i, rst_ni==1, condition (sha3_fsm==StIdle && (msgfifo_empty || SecIdleAcceptSwMsg)) is false

assumptions.claim: External logic must set SecIdleAcceptSwMsg such that it allows idle_o assertion only when it is safe to accept a new message despite a non-empty FIFO.
assumptions.risk: If SecIdleAcceptSwMsg is incorrectly asserted while msgfifo is not empty, idle_o incorrectly indicates idle, potentially allowing unintended message acceptance, data corruption, or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The condition (msgfifo_empty || SecIdleAcceptSwMsg) allows idle_o to be true even when msgfifo_empty is false if SecIdleAcceptSwMsg is true. It is unclear whether this bypass is a secure operation; it could allow new message injection while previous data remains in the FIFO.
uncertain_points.cond: sha3_fsm == StIdle and SecIdleAcceptSwMsg is true
uncertain_points.risk: Potential unauthorized message acceptance, data mixing, or security vulnerability.

uncertain_points.claim: The source and control logic of SecIdleAcceptSwMsg is external to this chunk; its timing, stability, and combinational path to this flop may affect idle_o correctness.
uncertain_points.risk: If SecIdleAcceptSwMsg glitches or is asynchronous, idle_o may have metastable or incorrect value.
